answer: the rubbish is collected every tuesday
other_correct: every tuesday the rubbish is collected
sense_problem: Card 'tuesday' is lower case; a day name needs a capital, and a learner may hesitate.

instruction_problem: Task has an active verb in a passive-voice exercise, so it is a trap/unclear why it is here; two answers (happened / was happening, the latter less natural).
sense_problem: Not a passive item; sits oddly among passive tasks.

answer: My phone was repaired in only twenty minutes yesterday.
other_correct: My phone got repaired in only twenty minutes yesterday.

answer: My keys were found in the car.
other_correct: My keys were found in the car by someone.
My keys were found by someone in the car.
instruction_problem: Instruction shows markdown asterisks around 'My keys'. 'by someone' is optional, so learners may disagree on whether to include it.

answer: A lot of rice is grown in this region.
other_correct: A lot of rice is grown in this region by them.
